review_scope: Contract and governance only; no numerical campaign executed.

critical_factor.metric: abs(lambda_qf - lambda_oracle) / abs(lambda_oracle) for non-zero oracle factors
critical_factor.zero_oracle_rule: Use a pre-declared and justified case scale for absolute error; never divide by an invented floor.
critical_factor.sign_rule: The QF and oracle factors must have the same sign when the oracle factor is non-zero.
critical_factor.tolerance: Declared per analytical/reference oracle before execution under TOL-026-ANALYTICAL-001.
critical_factor.limitation: No universal buckling-factor percentage is approved.

eigenpair_residual.metric: norm(K phi + lambda Kg phi) / max(norm(K phi) + abs(lambda) * norm(Kg phi), scale_floor)
eigenpair_residual.near_zero: scale_floor is case-declared; near-zero denominators require absolute residual and finite-zero evidence, not automatic PASS.

mesh_refinement.limitation: Mode changes, near-degenerate factors and formulation sensitivity require explicit bounded limitations or Owner disposition.

requirements: deterministic sign at maximum absolute component
mode_quality.mac: Reported only for DOF-compatible comparable references; no multi-mode qualification.

external_correlation.calculix: Required when a comparable solid deck is in the claimed external scope and the tool is available.
external_correlation.code_aster: SKIPPED_NOT_COMPARABLE for the currently audited 3D solid eigen-buckling route.
external_correlation.abaqus: COULD and optional when legally and technically available.
external_correlation.unavailable: SKIPPED_EXTERNAL_UNAVAILABLE is never PASS and blocks the affected external claim unless explicitly excluded by Owner.
external_correlation.tolerance: Oracle-specific and declared before execution; historical adapter screens are not universal G08 bands.

qualified_scope_candidate.claim: bounded first tangent-instability factor and mode evidence only
